article.title: Sino-coreano para minutos
article.chapter: Números, clasificadores, hora y fecha — 수사·단위명사·시간·날짜

claims.summary: KRdict defines 분 (分), sense 4, as a bound noun for a unit of time equal to one-sixtieth of an hour and lists 일 분, 이 분, 삼십 분, and 몇 분.
The National Institute of Korean Language says 분 is expressed only with Sino-Korean numerals; the cited answer addresses 열 시 십 분 as the expression for 10:10.

locator.source: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean-English Learners’ Dictionary, headword 분 (分), sense 4
locator.detail: Sense 4 defines 분 as one-sixtieth of an hour; examples 일 분, 이 분, 삼십 분, 몇 분; marks the entry as Sino-Korean.

links.notes: Definición y ejemplos se limitan al sentido 4 exacto.

locator.source: 국립국어원, 온라인가나다, response to “열 시 열 분은 왜 안 되나요?”, 2025-05-08
locator.detail: Answer at lines 196–200: 시 is usually expressed with native numerals though Sino-Korean numerals are possible; 분 is expressed only with Sino-Korean numerals. The query at lines 185–187 compares 열 시 십 분 and 열 시 열 분.

links.notes: Se cita la regla expresa para 분 y el ejemplo de la consulta; se retiraron afirmaciones sobre honorífico personal y otras unidades no cubiertas.
